children: rose 3.21%, after Rothschild & Co. Redburn initiated both neoclouds with Sell ratings, arguing that credit markets are pricing in risks equities still aren't. The firm set an $84 price target on Nebius and $54 on CoreWeave. The same note started coverage on six Bitcoin miners that have pivoted into AI infrastructure, Core Scientific

Rothschild's central argument is that hyperscalers carry more real economic leverage than their balance sheets show once off-balance-sheet commitments are counted, a dynamic the firm says could limit the next leg of AI infrastructure spending. "Credit markets are beginning to price risks that equities largely ignore," the firm wrote. Nebius carries the most downside in Rothschild's view, while CoreWeave has less downside risk but a risk-reward the firm still considers unattractive enough to warrant a Sell.

title: Nebius, CoreWeave Get Sell Calls as Credit Flashes Warning
